runs.text: Here is a truth that surprises many people. A guest who complains is often giving you a gift, because they are telling you what is wrong instead of quietly leaving and posting a bad review. How you respond in that moment can either lose them for good or win them for years. Service professionals call this service recovery, and studies show that a complaint handled well can leave a guest more loyal than they were before the problem happened.
